data.title: 爱西亚 · 浴室水汽中的羞怯回眸
data.description: 热气蒸腾的温暖浴室中弥漫着雏菊浴盐的芬芳。爱西亚坐在温润的浴凳上，双手小心翼翼地把纯白浴巾护在身前。湿漉漉的金发贴在娇小圆润的香肩上，水珠顺着白皙如玉的背脊滑落。她侧过微红的小脸回眸望来，翠绿双瞳如受惊的小鹿般羞怯微颤，却又带着无限的欣喜与信赖。
data.location: steamy private bathroom with aromatic bath bubbles
data.action: sitting on bath stool in steamy bathroom, holding white bath towel covering front, bare shoulders and back glistening with water drops, wet blonde hair, shy blushing glance over shoulder
data.lighting: soft diffused warm bathroom light filtering through dense steam mist
data.mood: tender innocent bashfulness, pure heart-melting vulnerability
data.promptProse: Sitting on a wooden bath stool in a steamy bathroom, Asia holds a fluffy white towel securely in front of her. Her damp blonde hair rests against dewy bare shoulders as she glances back with a shy, adorable blush.
data.animaCaption: Asia sitting in a steamy bathroom holding a white towel, looking back with shy green eyes.
